test_hicPlotMatrix_cool_log_region1_region2_without_cool_suffix: cooler.fileops.is_cooler recognises the file without the suffix. Budget: the harness recognises matrices by their suffix, so this input is not measured; the declared 90 MB is the budget the same file receives as Li_et_al_2015.cool in hicPlotMatrix.cool_region_region2. Tolerance 0.02 instead of 5: the matrix holds balanced, non-integer values, which the C++ tool hands to the drawing layer as float32 (the Python tool draws float64); rounding to float32 (relative 6e-8) moves a few pixels across a colour boundary. Measured RMS 0.0096, every other case of this file is at RMS 0.

test_hicPlotMatrix_perChr (--perChr abbreviates --perChromosome). cpp_args: --noDownsample. This figure has more bins along an axis than the axes have pixels, so by default the C++ tool draws blocks of bins (sum or mean of the cells of a block) instead of single bins; that changes the pixels by design, so the case compares the full resolution, tiled path with the Python figure instead. The default reduction is checked by the case with the suffix _reduced.
